ValidationRule.description: When Opportunity stage is changed to “Closed Lost”, Prompt the user to enter the “Close Lost Reason” and “Close Lost Description”
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR ($RecordType.Name = "Agent Acquisition", $RecordType.Name = "Renewal -Agent Acquisition"), ISPICKVAL(StageName ,"Closed Lost"), ISBLANK(Closed_Lost_Reason__c ) )
